metadata.name: Continuwuity
metadata.description: Continuwuity v26.7.2 is a community-driven Matrix homeserver and the continuation of conduwuit.
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: CONTINUWUITY_SERVER_NAME
environment_variables.description: Matrix server name. Cannot be changed after the first start without wiping the database.

environment_variables.name: CONTINUWUITY_DATABASE_PATH
environment_variables.description: Database directory. Must match the data volume mount.

environment_variables.name: CONTINUWUITY_ADDRESS
environment_variables.description: Bind address. 0.0.0.0 listens on all interfaces inside the container.

environment_variables.name: CONTINUWUITY_PORT
environment_variables.description: Port Continuwuity listens on inside the container.

environment_variables.name: CONTINUWUITY_ALLOW_FEDERATION
environment_variables.description: Federation is off until a reverse proxy serves this homeserver over HTTPS.

before_install.en_us: Set CONTINUWUITY_SERVER_NAME to your real Matrix domain before the first start. It is a literal environment value. CasaOS and ZimaOS do not substitute Compose variables. It cannot be changed later without wiping the database. Federation is disabled. Put an HTTPS reverse proxy in front of port 8008 before you set CONTINUWUITY_ALLOW_FEDERATION to true. The first start prints a one-time registration token in the container logs.
